heading.title: Rules in cases of Intestates other than Parsis

article.title: Where intestate has left child or children only.
article.content: Where the intestate has left surviving him a child or children, but no more remote lineal descendant through a deceased child, the property shall belong to his surviving child, if there is only one, or shall be equally divided among all his surviving children.
article.html:
37Where intestate has left child or children only.

Section 37 · Part V · Chapter II · page 23 of the Act

Where the intestate has left surviving him a child or children, but no more remote lineal descendant through a deceased child, the property shall belong to his surviving child, if there is only one, or shall be equally divided among all his surviving children.
